quality.review_scope: Core CdSe/PerCA4 layer-by-layer film preparation, its necessary PerCA4 precursor preparation, and directly linked product evidence. Optical n=1–5 and n=10 thickness are separate source contexts, without physical-batch joins. Upstream cited recipes and performance/control branches remain pending.
missing_fields: Upstream CdSe growth and PVBH synthesis delegated to external reference 28.
Substrate cleaning and priming exposure; bath volumes; deposition temperature/atmosphere; transfer rinsing/drying; exact batch identities; particle crystal phase and atomistic coordinates.
conflicts: Scheme 1 draws ITO/PerCA4/CdSe, whereas Sections 2.2/3.2 describe PVBH-primed ITO followed by alternating CdSe then PerCA4. Scheme is contextual only.
Functional-stack notation ITO/CdSe/(PerCA4/CdSe)9 in Figures 2–3 is not silently equated to (CdSe/PerCA4)10 thickness. Functional comparisons remain pending.
requested_tasks: Independent full audit of this core-scoped preparation; other variants remain pending.
